episode.title: This KEY Is NOT Supposed To PULL THINGS?!

synopsis: A man discovers a common house key that, instead of unlocking, inexplicably pulls small objects towards itself with an invisible force.
narration: Found this old key in a drawer, and it started doing this weird thing. It's not magnetic, I swear... just pulls everything closer.

shots.prompt: Photoreal close-up on ihsan_maker's hand holding a common brass house key slightly above a worn wooden desk. The view stays in one unchanging position and angle for the whole shot. A small metal screw lying on the desk visibly slides a few centimeters across the surface towards the key with an inexplicable force. He is wearing a plain black crew-neck t-shirt.

Photoreal mid-shot of ihsan_maker's hand testing the key over a small, lightweight plastic bead on the wooden desk. The view stays in one unchanging position and angle for the whole shot. The plastic bead, defying material properties, slowly but visibly slides towards the key, coming to rest against its side. He is wearing a plain black crew-neck t-shirt.

Photoreal close-up on ihsan_maker's hand holding the brass key over a small pile of various light objects (paper clips, a small coin, a button) on the wooden desk. The view stays in one unchanging position and angle for the whole shot. All the objects lift slightly from the surface and cluster impossibly around the key, holding themselves aloft. He is wearing a plain black crew-neck t-shirt.

Photoreal close-up on ihsan_maker's hand gently placing the key back onto the wooden desk. The view stays in one unchanging position and angle for the whole shot. Several small, non-magnetic objects remain inexplicably clinging to the shaft of the key, defying gravity and material science, as if subtly glued to it. He is wearing a plain black crew-neck t-shirt.

music: A sparse, dry, percussive bed built from soft taps, low woody hits and one quiet sustained tone, opening with sound in the very first second. Mostly negative space so the sounds of the work stay in front; slow steady pulse, no melody line, no swell, no ethereal pads, and no vocals.
